verdict.rationale: Claude Code offers the official Agent SDK, letting developers build their own agents with full control over orchestration, tool access, and permissions, on top of Claude Code's tools/capabilities — a direct SDK for AI-native builders. This is backed by first-party docs and complemented by API-key-based programmatic access (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) for direct integration. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer reports building production apps with the Agent SDK, and deeper docs on SDK language coverage/versioning.
